EXTENDS Halt
LOCAL INSTANCE Naturals
SCDraw_Halt_TLC == INSTANCE TLC

SCDraw_Halt_Mark == IF SCDraw_Halt_Broken = {} THEN TRUE ELSE SCDraw_Halt_TLC!PrintT(<<"00000000000000000000000000000000", <<x>>, SCDraw_Halt_Broken>>)
====
